title: People as Resource
subtitle: Understanding Human Capital in Economics
subject: Social Science
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of human resource.
Analyze the role of education and health in human capital formation.
Understand the nature of unemployment in India.

ai_context.learning_goal: To make the student realize that a population is an asset (human resource) rather than a liability.
common_misconceptions: Only physical labor is considered a resource.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student how their current education is making them a 'resource' for the future.
